discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology went from basic peptide-hormone discovery to drugs with huge clinical and public health impact on diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular outcomes. The work has already won the Lasker (2024) and Breakthrough Prizes. The 2025 prize went to immune tolerance, so a metabolic or physiological topic is plausible next.
